name: thesis-mcwm-explore-v5
source_weight_rule: floor + (1-floor)*exp(-0.5*mean(squared standardized global residual)); outside target support use floor; zero-time and terminal transitions retain unit weight
decision_reference: Frozen deterministic-policy target-critic/IQL mixture at each model refresh; no entropy term; calibration proxy, not the stochastic training backup
selection_data: Existing target calibration split only; stopping split determines normalizing scales; no SUMO evaluation outcomes used
actor_data: Unchanged 50:50 target offline and source online states for all arms
source_weight_scope: Source physical nonterminal real TD loss only; offline TD, actor batches and generated model TD remain unchanged
shared_heads: One encoder per member; independent event, duration, service, headway and cost heads; no input masks or cost-on-predicted-global conditioning
primary_comparison: Every new arm against a fresh same-budget normalized arm, with paired seeds and evaluation days
interpretation: Development exploration on previously used evaluation scenarios; preserve all negative results; no independent confirmation claim
